slides.text: Here's the paradox: Small organizations often have the least fundraising capacity
Yet they serve some of the most vulnerable communities
They're not less impactful. Just less visible.
Financial health isn't about size. It's about sustainability.
A small org with 12 months of reserve is stable.
A large org with 2 months is fragile.
Context matters. Data matters. Transparency matters.
Understand nonprofit financial health at daanaa.org
